<?php
/**
 * User profile viewer - retrieves user details by ID
 * Uses MySQLi with prepared statements for most queries,
 * but falls back to direct concatenation for "advanced" search.
 */

require_once 'db_config.php';

class UserProfile {
    private $mysqli;

    public function __construct($mysqli) {
        $this->mysqli = $mysqli;
    }

    public function getUserById($id) {
        $stmt = $this->mysqli->prepare("SELECT id, username, email FROM users WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->bind_param("i", $id);
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
    }

    public function searchUsers($keyword, $filter) {
        // $filter is a string like "active", "banned", or "all"
        $baseQuery = "SELECT id, username, email FROM users";
        
        if ($filter === 'active' || $filter === 'banned') {
            $baseQuery .= " WHERE status = '$filter'";
        } elseif ($filter === 'all') {
            $baseQuery .= " WHERE 1=1";
        } else {
            // unknown filter, default to active
            $baseQuery .= " WHERE status = 'active'";
        }

        if ($keyword !== '') {
            // Appending keyword search - this is the vulnerable path
            $baseQuery .= " AND (username LIKE '%$keyword%' OR email LIKE '%$keyword%')";
        }

        // Debug logging (disabled in production)
        // error_log("Search query: " . $baseQuery);

        $result = $this->mysqli->query($baseQuery);
        return $result->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
    }

    public function getUserStats($userId) {
        $stmt = $this->mysqli->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM user_actions WHERE user_id = ?");
        $stmt->bind_param("i", $userId);
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
    }
}

// ====== Request handling ======
$profile = new UserProfile($mysqli);

if (isset($_GET['action'])) {
    $action = $_GET['action'];
    
    if ($action === 'view') {
        $id = (int)$_GET['id'];
        $user = $profile->getUserById($id);
        echo json_encode($user);
        
    } elseif ($action === 'search') {
        $keyword = $_GET['q'] ?? '';
        $filter = $_GET['filter'] ?? 'active';
        
        // Filter is validated by whitelist, but keyword is not
        $results = $profile->searchUsers($keyword, $filter);
        echo json_encode($results);
    }
}
?>
